# WoW AndroWhere 0.9.3

- **Your own server: the login server starts.** In 0.9.2 it stopped right away because it couldn't look up the address 127.0.0.1 on Android. The server is rebuilt with that fixed, and with an encryption module the world server needs when you log in. After updating, press Continue setup on On this device: it downloads the new server (about 18 MB) and keeps your account and characters.

## Install

Download **WoW-AndroWhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.9.2 and keeps your settings, saved login, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
